verdict.rationale: Mollie documents user-configured background processes that run on their own. Through the Subscriptions API, Mollie "automatically create[s] recurring payments for you at the interval you specified," and recurring payments "happen in the background" after the first checkout. Application fees are also moved automatically when a payment succeeds. These are fixed, payment-specific automations rather than a general automation or workflow builder. missing for 10: a general-purpose automation or rules engine for arbitrary background tasks, scheduling beyond recurring charges, agent-driven autonomous workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
